verdict.rationale: Mercury documents scoped API tokens with fine-grained permissions in three types (read-only, read-write, and custom), and access can be revoked at any time from the dashboard. That covers the core of issuing least-privilege credentials for an agent, and approval-gated disbursements add a further guardrail on agent write actions. Missing for 10: detail on what the custom scopes can actually restrict (per-endpoint, per-account or per-action), agent-specific credential guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
